guide1: Gather. Stand by the birch, a rock or the berries and press Space. Every swing is a VRF roll: 1 in 400 is an aberration worth 20.
guide2: Earn Glints. Open the pack (E), pick an item, Sell to Pell. The workbench turns wood and ore into gear.
guide3: Fight. The Bramble Cellars are six rooms; bosses drop sealed rimeshells. Space swings, Shift dashes.
guide4: Gamble. Thaw a rimeshell to see what was sealed inside, or list it sealed at the Coldfair. Feed gear to the Anvil for a better one.
guide5: Kill the wyrm. Everyone hits one dragon in the Noonless Crater. Its health is hidden. When it dies, each slayer claims Glints and devnet SOL.
